fields.label: Environment
fields.options:
sandbox
dev
simulation
preprod
prod
production

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: Which invoices this unit signs - used by utils.invoice.get_egs_unit_for_invoice to pick the right unit per invoice. This is ERPNext-side routing only; it does not control what invoice-type capability ZATCA itself grants the certificate (that's negotiated during onboarding and has so far always come back Standard-only regardless of what's picked here).

fields.label: Transaction Type
fields.description: STANDARD = Sales Invoices (B2B, cleared). SIMPLIFIED = POS Invoices (B2C, reported). BOTH if this unit's CSID covers both.

fields.label: POS Profile
fields.description: Ties this unit to one POS terminal's invoices. Leave blank for a company-wide SIMPLIFIED fallback.

fields.label: Branch
fields.description: Ties this unit to one branch's Sales Invoices. Leave blank for a company-wide STANDARD fallback.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
CCSID Issued
Compliance Passed
Production
Failed

fields.label: Is Active
fields.description: Exactly one Production unit should be active per (Company, Environment, Transaction Type, POS Profile/Branch) - issuing a new Production CSID for the same scope automatically deactivates older ones.

The digital-stamp id returned by the onboarding engine's /onboarding/prepare call. Every subsequent call for this unit is addressed by this id. The engine still generates and persists the CCSID/PCSID credentials and private key itself, but once a Production CSID is issued this app fetches a one-time copy into the Signing Credentials section below, so invoice signing doesn't need to call the engine every time.
fields.label: Stamp ID

fields.description: Invoice Counter Value (ICV) of the last invoice reported through this unit. ZATCA requires ICVs to increase by one per invoice from the same EGS unit - allocated by utils.invoice.allocate_icv, don't edit it by hand.
fields.label: Last ICV

fields.description: The engine no longer returns the PCSID certificate, so this isn't read from it - it defaults to 5 years after issuance/renewal per ZainZone's guidance, not a value confirmed with ZATCA.
fields.label: PCSID Expires On (assumed)

fields.description: Cached locally from the engine's one-time /onboarding/{stamp_id}/credentials call, made right after a Production CSID is issued or renewed. This is what invoice signing reads - it never calls the engine per invoice.
fields.label: Signing Credentials

fields.description: The Production CSID (binarySecurityToken) matching the stored private key.
fields.label: PCSID

fields.description: Private key generated for this unit's CSR. A new key pair is issued on every renewal, replacing this value.
fields.label: Private Key

fields.description: Secret paired with the PCSID for Basic Auth against ZATCA's reporting/clearance APIs.
fields.label: PCSID Secret
